summary: Urgent releases reach your installation within minutes instead of overnight.

new.title: Update now within 15 minutes
new.text: When Invardia marks a release 'update now' for your ring, your installation starts the update within about 15 minutes. It does so only when updates are on.

new.title: Setup scripts run their own version
new.text: The setup scripts on invardia.com now run the version they were published for, instead of the newest release.
